about.title: About — IIPHA
about.claim: An association of healthcare professionals of Persian heritage, working on medical issues tied to justice and human rights in Iran.
about.orgName: International Independent Iranian Physicians and Healthcare Providers Association
about.lead: IIPHA is a non-profit organization based in the United States, and is non-partisan.
about.vision: To build a connected community that creates real opportunities for humanitarian and professional contribution, particularly in response to crises affecting Iran.
about.mission: To monitor and advocate for healthcare standards, and to translate that advocacy into concrete action.
about.work: IIPHA works to unite and give voice to the Iranian diaspora’s civil society, engaging with media, international organizations, and decision-makers on medical issues tied to justice and human rights in Iran.
about.contactBody: For membership, media, or partnership enquiries.

donate.title: Donate — IIPHA
donate.lead: As a non-profit, we depend on donations and membership fees.

ways.label: Become a member
ways.body: If you are a healthcare provider outside Iran, the most direct way to help is to become a member.

ways.label: Volunteer
ways.body: If you are not a healthcare provider, you can still give your time and professional skills to the work.

ways.label: Donate
ways.body: Otherwise, you can donate any amount, starting at $10.

donate.banner: Contributions go primarily toward the human rights lawyers working with us.
donate.note: For membership or volunteering, write to info@iipha.org.
